title: Twelve, iv
logline: Friday. Morning. Wood off shift at seven, walking to Gully's to get the dog. The dog at the door already. Three wide panels: the walk, the door, the two of them going home slowly in the day.

panels.composition: Main street at 7 AM, gray. WOOD in the polo under a coat, walking. The Lanes' sign on the hill, S dark, the rest off for the day.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a wide panel of a thin man in a coat walking down a gray small-town street at dawn, a bowling-alley sign on a hill behind with one letter dark, no words

panels.composition: Gully's door. BARNABY already at it, inside, standing, waiting. GULLY opening it. The dog out before it's open.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a wide panel of a shack door being opened by a man in an apron as an old dog squeezes out toward a thin man arriving, no words

panels.composition: The two of them going home up the street, slowly, in full day, the man matching the dog. The panel wider than any daily before it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, an extra-wide panel of a thin man and an old dog walking slowly up a small-town street in morning light, matching each other's pace, no words
image.notes: Draw this panel wider than the other two. The widest daily panel of Run 3.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: Off shift at seven. The dog at the door. The widest panel.
